verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a JS-rendering scraping service, but the pack never documents persistent browser profiles, saved cookies, or login state reused across requests. The closest items are 'managed browser sessions' (Browser Sandbox) and continuing to interact with a scraped page. Those describe an interactive session, not a reusable profile, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reuse a persistent browser profile with saved cookies and login state across multiple requests
